findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 343 requests to 83 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 9.6 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 5.4 MB (56%) came from third-party domains, 2.5 MB of it from services classified as tracking (171 requests).

39 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), bidr.io (Beeswax, advertising), bidswitch.net (Iponweb (BidSwitch), advertising), blismedia.com (Blis, advertising), casalemedia.com (Index Exchange, advertising).
126 cookies were set by third-party domains (179 cookies in total).
